questions.question: Which language should the volunteer mobile app use?

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Recommended for a typed cross-platform mobile application.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Use JavaScript for the mobile application.

questions.question: Which mobile framework should the app use?

options.label: React Native
options.description: Cross-platform mobile UI; native Bluetooth and Wi-Fi Direct integration may require platform-specific modules.

options.label: Ionic
options.description: Web-based cross-platform UI; verify offline and peer-to-peer hardware support for the target phones.

options.label: Other
options.description: Specify a preferred framework or target platform.

questions.question: What user-facing features or target-device constraints should the mobile app support?
questions.answer: Offline voice/text reporting, triage and priority-map views, and Android phone support; retain voice recordings only if needed.
questions.recommendedChoice: Offline voice/text reporting, triage and priority-map views, and Android phone support; retain voice recordings only if needed.

questions.question: Which language should the on-device processing and synchronization service use?

options.label: Python
options.description: Matches the proposed Whisper small, lightweight classifier, SQLite, and Folium stack.

options.label: Other
options.description: Specify another language if required by on-device deployment constraints.

questions.question: Which framework should the local processing service use?

options.label: FastAPI
options.description: A lightweight Python API framework for a local-only interface between the mobile UI and processing components.

options.label: Flask
options.description: A small Python framework if a minimal local HTTP interface is preferred.

options.label: Other
options.description: Specify a framework or a framework-free embedded design.

questions.question: What processing, synchronization, and offline behavior should this service provide?
questions.answer: Run Whisper small and a lightweight urgency/needs classifier on-device; persist reports in SQLite; synchronize locally over Bluetooth/Wi-Fi Direct using CRDT-style conflict handling; operate without cloud or internet.
questions.recommendedChoice: Run Whisper small and a lightweight urgency/needs classifier on-device; persist reports in SQLite; synchronize locally over Bluetooth/Wi-Fi Direct using CRDT-style conflict handling; operate without cloud or internet.

options.label: SQLite
options.description: Local structured storage for reports and triage state; supports offline operation.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Include only if voice recordings or other media require object storage. The stated zero-cloud requirement calls for local device file storage instead; confirm whether recordings are retained.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Choose only if the app does not persist reports or other data.

questions.question: Do users need to sign in to use application API features?

options.label: Yes
options.description: Users must sign in to use application API features.

options.label: No
options.description: No sign-in is required for application API features.
